name: Oseja de Sajambre (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of green, white, blue, white and green crossed by a broad red band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the upper hoist with a white chamois.
history: Municipal flag of Oseja de Sajambre; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
